summary: Candidate 02 is the only option that names both method series without reinterpreting one series as uncertainty. It needs stronger foreground contrast and slightly larger typography for reliable reading in a short demo.

findings.evidence: Candidate 01 treats the two method columns as lower and upper uncertainty bounds even though the input columns are named baseline and candidate.
findings.recommendation: Select the explicit multi-line comparison instead of presenting method values as uncertainty.

findings.evidence: Candidate 03 draws both lines but provides no legend, so the method identities cannot be recovered from the image.
findings.recommendation: Use Candidate 02, which includes a series legend.

findings.evidence: Candidate 02 uses pale axis and label colors that become difficult to read at video playback size.
findings.recommendation: Apply the high-contrast palette and increase the minimum font size.
